main_issue: Who covers Agent D's half-finished pitch section while D is at the wake and funeral; D ends up offering to finish it from home themselves.

A-B.evidence: A proposes splitting the section three ways (T3); B refuses (T6); A accepts 'Understood' (T7); the matter is later settled by D's offer, with no further disagreement.

A-C.evidence: A asks C how much they can take on (T7); C says they can't (T8); A then goes with D's offer (T10-12) and no conflict remains.

A-D.evidence: D first says they can't work (T2); then offers to finish at home (T9); A says 'quickest if you do it' (T10); D: 'I'll do it' (T11); A: 'Thank you... huge help' (T12).

B-C.evidence: B (T6) and C (T8) each decline to take on the work, but neither addresses the other.

B-D.evidence: B declines to cover (T6); D then offers to do it themselves (T9, T11); B says 'Look after yourself' (T13); D thanks B (T14).

C-D.evidence: C says they can't do D's analysis (T8); D offers to finish it or walk someone through it (T9); C expresses sympathy (T21) and D thanks them (T22).
